hypothesis: Observed SOXX-only history can be extended to2006-10-10 with the existing published affine operator while preserving all2010+canonical prices bit-for-bit. No SOXL synthesis, prediction or portfolio result is inferred.

calendar.interpretation: Independent retrospective native session reference only; early backfilled VVIX values never become features or PIT evidence.

capture.authorization_boundary: Root must review this plan/API contract before the new OpenD capture; no implicit login/service mutation.
sequence: request_history_kline(US.SOXX,NONE) all pages under one date interval
capture.original_response_archives: Full decoded quote/history/rehab SDK tuples; per-request timestamps, return status, page count and sha256. No account/global-state/login APIs.
capture.pagination: Pass the last returned opaque page key in memory; request metadata records only page_number and has_prior_page_key, never user/account/authentication keys.
capture.failure: Unavailable port/empty or incomplete history -> needs data; missing permission/login -> needs auth. Do not start/upgrade/login/subscribe, silently shift date boundary, change source or fill rows.

price_contract.source: Futu unadjusted observed OHLCV plus published rehab events
price_contract.price_operator: Only bar_date<event_date<=as_of; chronological A<-A*a; B<-B*a+b; adjusted_OHLC=NONE_OHLC*A+B
price_contract.volume_operator: NONE volume divided by product of exact split_base/split_ert or join_base/join_ert
price_contract.reuse_transform: src.data.published_price_basis.build_published_basis; only SOXX rows. Supply the unchanged parent SOXL rehab table solely because this transformation helper validates both rehab keys; never create/fetch SOXL bars.
price_contract.single_asset_qualification: New explicit SOXX-only audit; do not monkeypatch INSTRUMENTS or modify dual-asset validate_price_basis/build_qualified_price_store.

gates.raw_receipt_order: rehab_before_received <= first_history_requested; each page received <= next requested; final_history_received <= rehab_after_requested
gates.new_rehab_stability: before/after full tables identical including dtype/order; no hidden deduplication
gates.raw_physical: unique chronological canonical dates; finite positive OHLCV; low<=open/close<=high; no as_of future market rows
gates.full_calendar: exact5021 dates equal the independent native reference;859early+4162overlap; no missing/extra/drop/fill
gates.parent_raw_overlap: all4162SOXX dates and float64OHLCV exactly equal parent NONE rows
gates.parent_rehab: all formula-used historical exdates/forwardA/B/exact split/join fields throughas_of equal parent; unused metadata differences only logged; postasof events excluded and disclosed
gates.published_overlap: new float64OHLCV for all4162parent sessions array_equal parent qualified SOXX values; source lineage metadata is allowed to differ honestly
gates.native_readback: qlib.init + D.calendar + D.list_instruments + D.features; universe exactlySOXX; five field files; stored float32 values array_equal transformed float32; post2010 native values array_equal parent provider SOXX
gates.immutability: hash parent provider and Recorder artifacts before/after; no old source/helper/provider writes; new destination must not exist before build

validation.focused: synthetic response/capture audit, missing/future/duplicate/nonphysical rows, rehab drift, parent hash/overlap drift, single-asset native roundtrip and exact preserved overlap; no market model or backtest
validation.notebook: execute source qualification Data API/Recorder/readback, Chinese conclusion and aligned summary

artifact_policy.raw_archives: explicit capture manifest under data/raw/external; SDK logs/caches outside repo

limitations: 2001-07-10through2006-10-09SOXXhistory remains needs data; no claim of since-inception coverage.
No SOXL prices, labels or features are fabricated before its inception.
Published affine basis is retrospective and is not exact SDKQFQ, independently verified exchange ground truth, total-return/distribution accounting or historical-PIT certification.
Additional past crisis data are newly ingested but not new forward investment evidence.
No training, signal generation, forecast, backtest or stable-excess qualification is part of this data card.
